ventral_fluke_pixel_intensity_distributi.global_contrast_ratio: High-intensity white pixels occupy approximately 65% of the visible surface, with low-intensity black pixels providing sharp contrast at the margins and in mottled clusters.
ventral_fluke_pixel_intensity_distributi.spatial_color_mapping: Left lobe presents a dominant white contiguous field with black linear intrusions and peripheral black edging. Right lobe exhibits a high-density cluster of discrete, roughly circular black maculae (spots) distributed across a white background, concentrated towards the trailing edge.

trailing_edge_2d_geometric_contour.median_notch_angle: The central depression forms a sharp V-shaped convergence; however, the apex is partially occluded by water turbulence and spray, preventing exact angle calculation.
trailing_edge_2d_geometric_contour.edge_topography_serration_map: Extremely irregular trailing edge with high-frequency, varying-amplitude serrations. Distinct peaks are visible every 15-40 pixels, with deeper indentations noted on the inner half of the right lobe.
trailing_edge_2d_geometric_contour.lobe_sweep_trajectory: Lobed surfaces exhibit a broad convexity moving from the center, transitioning into a sharp, upward-curving tip (falcate appearance) at the distal ends.

localized_surface_anomalies.rosette_scar_constellations: Densely packed clusters of high-intensity white, calcified protrusions (barnacles) are concentrated along the outer tips and leading edges of both lobes, forming irregular rosette patterns.
localized_surface_anomalies.linear_abrasions: Significant series of dark, sub-parallel linear streaks (likely rake marks) are detected on the white surface of the left lobe, running diagonally from the trailing edge toward the fluke center.

acquired_anomalies_or_scars: Extensive barnacle colonization on both distal tips; significant vertical linear scarring on the lower left lobe near the peduncle junction.
other_distinctive_markers: The right lobe features a highly unique, dense leopard-like pigmentation pattern consisting of over 30 distinct black ovoid spots.
